Specification: This specification models a simple one-variable state machine whose single variable x is a record. The initial state sets x to the record [val |-> 0], and the next-state relation increments the value while x.val < 3, but once x.val >= 3 it assigns x to a differently shaped record [val2 |-> x.val + 1]. The temporal specification requires Init and then always [][Next]_<<x>>, so it describes all behaviors generated by this transition relation; notably, the change in record field names suggests the spec is intended to exercise or expose a runtime error or record-field access issue.
